reuse.why: All link-time rules go through one new link.prepareBankAccountLink used by every provider linker, and the unlink field-clearing is extracted into clearBankAccountLink and reused by unlinkAccount; Fintegra reuses findOrCreateBank, syncAccount and handleSyncResponse.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near-verbatim copy of the Akahu/SimpleFIN linker body and downloadFintegraTransactions is a copy of downloadAkahuTransactions differing only in the server URL and log text, following the tree's per-provider copy pattern rather than sharing it.

placement.why: Link preconditions and unlink state live in server/accounts/link.ts, provider download in sync.ts, server path in server-config.ts and types in types/models, matching the existing layering.

scope.why: Changes serve the four steps; the desktop-client edits are only the minimum needed for the provider type maps to type-check.

maintainability.why: A single link-precondition function with the replace flag is easy to own and extend; the copied Fintegra linker and downloader add two more places to keep in step with the other providers.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every linker, including Fintegra, calls prepareBankAccountLink; unlinkAccount and the replace path share clearBankAccountLink.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated Fintegra linker and downloader are plain copies of the Akahu versions, not reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: prepareBankAccountLink gains only the requested replaceExistingLink flag (step 4); the closed-account rule (step 3) is a general precondition rather than a special case, and no linker bypasses it.
